report.summary: Alex’s strongest keep themes are making 1:1 conversations feel heard and followed through, and being available to help unblock work while supporting solid standards. This builds trust, saves time, and helps the team keep moving. The main change theme is timeline communication: delivery expectations need clearer dates or confidence ranges, with earlier and more regular updates when they change.
